name: Dual Subs
description: Combines two existing text subtitle tracks into a new ASS track: the learned language at the bottom and the native language above it. Works in every Jellyfin client because the result is a normal external subtitle. Bitmap subtitles are skipped.
overview: Dual-language subtitles generated on the server for language learning

versions.changelog: Fixes the wrong-language track picked after a generated file was added. Jellyfin caches extracted embedded subtitles by stream index; adding an external file shifts those indexes. The plugin now detects that mismatch, clears the cache for the item and rebuilds the track, so items already broken by 1.0.0/1.0.1 heal on the next run. Generated files are also deleted by path, never by stream index.
